In order to meet the daily demands of data access and development, Enterprise Knowledge Engine provides data access modules to assist data developers in data processing, including data sets, data connections, data processing, and other functions.

<span id="d621be36"></span>
# Usage flow

Data access and development work involves the following steps:

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />


|**Step** |**Ability introduction** |**The basic work that the module must complete** |**Reference figure** |
|---|---|---|---|
|Step 1: Access to the original data source |The system provides 40 + data connection methods, making it convenient for enterprises to access data into the system, including but not limited to relational databases (such as MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, etc.), big data platforms (such as Hive, Impala, Clickhouse, etc.), MPP databases (Postgre, etc.), streaming databases (Kafka, etc.), text data (Excel, CSV), Feishu tables, API interfaces, etc. It can not only connect with the customer data and business data access of various business companies within the customer (such as membership system, member mid\-platform system, etc.), but also connect with the official website, APP, official account, WeCom, Ocean Engine and other data sources. |Required completion: Connect the required data to the system through the [Data Access] module. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/17da3946a4924d0885a260f5837db5f8~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
|Step 2: Data cleaning and processing |After the original data source is connected to the system, it cannot be used directly, and the data source needs to be edited and cleaned.<br><br>The system has built\-in lightweight data cleaning and visual modeling capabilities. By adding data processing nodes in the form of drag and drop, the data is screened, deduplicated, replaced and other cleaning operations. After the data cleaning is completed, the processed data can be output to the target source. |To complete: Process the data source. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/696b369bee784097a6bae48874250cd0~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
|Step 3: Output the dataset |A dataset is a data model composed of one or more tables, which is the basis for creating labels, groupings, and insights. Before applying data, it is necessary to connect the source data information of the data and output it into a dataset through the visual modeling function. |Required: Output the required dataset. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/570af437960a44a58c7eab41298a585b~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span> |
